description: This file implements the SerialPort class and related functionality for serial communication, including platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX systems, managing serial port configuration, opening, closing, reading, writing, and monitoring serial ports.

classes.name: SerialMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific class for monitoring serial port events on Windows, managing monitored ports, and handling asynchronous I/O.

methods.name: SerialPort::SerialPort
methods.description: Constructor initializing serial port with default or specified parameters.

methods.name: SerialPort::~SerialPort
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and closing the port.

methods.name: SerialPort::Configuration
methods.description: Configures serial port parameters such as baud rate, flow control, buffer sizes.

methods.name: SerialPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port for communication.

methods.name: SerialPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port and releases resources.

methods.name: SerialPort::Trigger
methods.description: Signals the port to perform an action, such as writing data.

methods.name: SerialPort::Events
methods.description: Returns the current event mask for polling.

methods.name: SerialPort::Handle
methods.description: Handles events based on the current port state and flags.

methods.name: SerialPort::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the serial port asynchronously.

methods.name: SerialPort::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the serial port asynchronously.
